scoring_justification: The headline quantities require a full DFT+transport pipeline that cannot be recomputed in the verifier; therefore the checker compares the agent's reported values against the paper's reported values with tolerances and direction checks.

outputs.description: Lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K for monolayer ZrSe2 and HfSe2.
Optimal thermoelectric figure of merit ZT and corresponding carrier concentration for n-type and p-type doping at 600 K and 1000 K.

lines: n-type ZT > p-type ZT at 1000 K for both materials
HfSe2 ZT > ZrSe2 ZT at 1000 K for n-type

outputs.description: Boolean trends derived from the computed ZT: n-type vs p-type superiority and HfSe2 vs ZrSe2 for n-type doping.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are computed from the first-principles pipeline. The lattice thermal conductivity is compared to the paper-reported value within tolerance; the optimal ZT is compared on a threshold-or-better basis where meeting or exceeding the reference earns full credit; the trend file is checked structurally for correctness of the two logical assertions.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold lattice thermal conductivity values at 300 K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Sec 3.3, Fig 5b: reported κ_l(300K) = 1.2 W/mK (ZrSe2) and 1.8 W/mK (HfSe2).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the headline quantity; they serve as the reference for the reproduction within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold optimal ZT values at 600 K and 1000 K for both doping types

hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from figure/text and reflected in the reference solve.sh; low-order values match the paper’s trend.
